remarks: The "Legacy Estate" An Oenoke Ridge Masterpiece: The main brick residence captures the essence of Gilded Age elegance with 10-12 ft ceilings, eight fireplaces, a classic wrap-around-porch, and a porte-cochere. Spanning four finished levels, the main residence seamlessly blends original character with a significant three-story addition completed in 2012. The newer wing features a spacious Smallbone gourmet kitchen, sun-drenched breakfast room, large working pantry, 2-sided fireplace, large center island fit for a master chef and an adjacent family room all designed for casual living and effortless entertaining. The main residence includes a luxurious owner suite with fireplace, balcony, marble bath and 2 walk-in-closets. There are six additional bedrooms on the upper levels. The home is rich with architectural character throughout. The property also includes: - Three Historic Barns: Versatile spaces for collectors, animal lovers, gardeners or car enthusiasts. Grounds: Set high on the ridge, 4 pastoral acres with an identified pool site, multiple gardens, and rolling lawns. Own a piece of New Canaan history on Oenoke Ridge.
